issues.title: Circular/Self-Referential Acceptance Criteria
issues.why: AC-CG-24 and AC-CG-21 declare that subfolder ACs are 'not missing' but 'delegated', yet the mediocre AI cannot see those subfolders due to context limits. The parent spec lacks the actual GWT logic for the languages it claims to govern.
issues.fix: Inline at least 3-5 core GWT criteria for each major language (Go, TS, Rust) directly into the parent 97-acceptance-criteria.md.

issues.title: Missing Worked Examples for Size-Limit Exceptions
issues.why: AC-CG-22 (Size-Limit Exception Ledger) defines complex detection rules (e.g., 'AST count: match-expression-line / total-line ≥ 0.6') without providing a sample calculation or code snippet.
issues.fix: Add a 'Worked Examples' section to §97 showing a Rust match block and the line-count math used to justify the exception.

issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency/Partial Failure in CI Gates
issues.why: AC-CG-19 mandates a tree-health gate ≥ 95/100 but does not define behavior when linter scripts (Go/Python mix) partially fail or timeout during large-scale (251 files) scans.
issues.fix: Define a 'Fail-Fast' policy in AC-CG-19: any script timeout or partial scan result defaults to a score of 0.
